cases.title: CDREBUILD warns first, says it does not save the drawing, rebuilds 11 pits and 49 pipes, the file on disk stays unchanged, and one U echoes CDREBUILD
cases.plan_item: UX-REP-01 CDREBUILD half (daily card D27) and UX-STD-03 CDREBUILD half (daily card D18)
cases.expected: Typing CDREBUILD on the untouched copy prints first '[CE] CDREBUILD will rebuild this drawing's stored pit and pipe data ... it does not save the drawing itself - you still decide when to do that. One U undoes it.', then '[CE] CDREBUILD complete: 11 pits, 49 pipes', and last '[CE] CE's stored pit and pipe data is up to date in this drawing. It does not save the drawing. Run PITSCHEDULE to verify output.'; it asks nothing; the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDREBUILD completed'; one U echoes CDREBUILD; the drawing file on disk keeps its SHA-256 and time, and the only new files beside it are CE's own _PRE_C7_ backups.
cases.why_not_unit: The order of the warning against the real rebuild, and whether anything wrote the file on disk, only show in a live AutoCAD session on a real drawing.
not_automated: The three Warning and Fix lines CDREBUILD prints about missing levels (X1, P9, P10 on this fixture) are recorded, not judged.
Whether the rebuilt records are right is not read here (R13 reads the Pit Schedule around CDSYNC; a schedule read around CDREBUILD is not in this draft).

cases.title: COPY of pit P3 makes one new pit numbered P8 flagged Check levels, the original pit's own label still reads P3, and one U takes the copy away
cases.plan_item: UX-EDIT-02 plain COPY, whole card (daily card D15)
cases.expected: Before the COPY the label 109E08 of pit P3 reads PIT_LABEL P3. Select pit P3 (109D56) and COPY it by 0,-5000 (Enter ends COPY): the command line says '1 pit copied and numbered as new. Check levels: they came across from the originals (the Inspector shows which ones to confirm).'; exactly one new PIT BLOCK and one new PIT LABEL are added and the new label reads P8; the label 109E08 still reads P3; one U echoes COPY and the object count returns to its value before the COPY; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: CE reacts to a real native COPY and renumbers the clone in the live drawing; only the live drawing shows that the original keeps its number.
not_automated: The Inspector's Check levels mark is a picture item (Codex).
A COPY that takes pipes with the pit ('1 pit and N pipes copied ...') is not driven.
